svg.title: A possible Two-Rail script family: comparative atlas
svg.desc: Seven fictional stages around Carlo's original Classical script. Identical modern keys din rento ghma and n p s r w are drawn in every hand. This compares writing shapes, not historical pronunciations or translations.

g.text: Provisional fictional history · the same modern keys in every hand · Classical is the original
